messages:
maria: Heads-up — compliance (security) flagged gaps: they need per-tenant visibility for routing policy changes and quota adjustments. We should decide what 'who changed what' looks like in the export and console.

alex: clarifying q: does compliance want full before/after diffs or just a pointer to the config version?

maria: they asked for both. auditor workflows expect a human-readable diff + machine-friendly export (NDJSON) that can stream into SIEM.

jon: +1 for NDJSON. streaming export also avoids huge dumps. we need cursor + rate limit for exports.

claire: UX question — in Console, do we show the full diff inline or an expandable snapshot? showing everything could be noisy for routing policy rollouts.

security: from the security team: need actor resolution (email/ID), timestamp, IP, change reason (if provided), and an export flag for PII redaction modes. retention default 90 days but should be configurable.

sam: technical constraints: routing policies are large JSON blobs. storing whole before/after for every change will blow up DB. alternatives: store config version id + store diffs as compact op sets.

maria: idea: store a compact NDJSON line for each change that has metadata and a small inline diff for important fields (route, weight, quota). full snapshot available via object store by version id.

alex: sample NDJSON line I'd expect for audit export: 
```json
{"ts":"1980012345","actor":"alice@redwood.com","action":"update","resource":{"type":"routing_policy","id":"rp-123"},"diff":{"route":{"from":"us-east","to":"us-west"},"quota":{"from":1000,"to":500}},"meta":{"policy_id":"rp-123","config_version":"v42","effective_at":"2024-10-12T15:03:00Z"}}
```

jon: that looks fine. add an optional `reason` and `actor_source` (UI/API/CLI) fields. also include `rollout_id` when change is from a canary/rollout so we can correlate.

claire: Console UX: show summary row with who/date/reason and a preview of important diffs. Expand to full diff and link to config version in object store. Add a small timeline UI for rollouts (canary steps).

security: export needs two modes: streaming NDJSON (for SIEM) and human CSV summarization (for legal). CSV should be sanitized. Also let's add `pii_scrubbed` flag.

infra-bot: perf note — generating full diffs on the fly for large configs will spike CPU during peak. we should precompute diff blobs at write time and write them to the audit store asynchronously.

sam: agreed. pipeline: write change event -> enqueue diff job -> compute compact diff + store full snapshot in object store -> mark export-ready. Exports read compact diffs and optionally fetch snapshots.

eva: what about quotas? they often change via tenancy scripts. Need separate event subtype `quota_adjustment` with `old_quota`, `new_quota`, `units` and `reason`. Also flag if adjustment affects billing.

maria: good call. we should also annotate whether the change impacts SLA targets so CS can be alerted.

alex: API shape proposal: GET /audit/events?tenant=xyz&after=cursor&types=routing_policy,quota&stream=true. Query params: redact=pii|none, include_snapshots=true|false, rollout_id=xxx.

jon: server-side stream with chunked NDJSON, keep export rate-limited by tenant quotas. also return `next_cursor` and estimated remaining count in headers.

claire: for Console downloads, add a 'prepare export' async job so UI can show progress and not block. link the job to an audit log entry so it's auditable.

security: one more — retention & deletion: when a tenant requests deletion, we must ensure audit entries that contain PII are scrubbed or moved to a legal hold. add `legal_hold` flag support.

maria: action items: 1) api contract PR for NDJSON lines (alex+jon), 2) diff compute pipeline design doc (sam+infra), 3) Console wireframes for diff preview + export flow (claire), 4) retention/legal hold spec (security+eva). I'll collate and set deadlines.

alex: I'll open the API PR with the sample shape and optional fields.

jon: I'll sketch the streaming headers and cursor semantics.

sam: started a draft for diff worker and object store lifecycle. will share later today.

claire: will mock screens by EOD for review.

maria: thanks all — moving this to a short RFC next week. :thumbsup:
